choice.basis: The dashboard legend maps pale yellow to 'High' (100) and dark burgundy to 'Low' (0). Missouri (MO) is colored pale yellow, indicating the highest incidence among the listed options, whereas Mississippi (MS) is dark burgundy (low) and Delaware (DE) is dark red (lower-middle). The routing criterion is the 'Highest incidence state in the dashboard' for the 'State incidence priority follow-up' workflow.
choice.option_label: Open Missouri (MO) incidence detail for priority follow-up
